explanation.ar: ACT أي Annual Change Traffic هو نسبة أسطر الكود المعدلة أو المضافة في سنة نموذجية إلى حجم النظام الكلي.
explanation.en: ACT (Annual Change Traffic) represents the fraction of software lines of code modified or added in a typical year relative to total system size: $\frac{\text{KLOC}_{\text{added}} + \text{KLOC}_{\text{modified}}}{\text{KLOC}_{\text{total}}}$.

explanation.en: Regression testing is essential during initial development (as new modules are integrated into growing builds) and throughout operational maintenance (as patches are deployed).

explanation.en: System documentation records architectural and development specifications (SRS, SDD, Test Plans, Data Dictionaries). System administration is an operational user manual rather than an internal system design artifact.

explanation.ar: الهندسة الأمامية Forward engineering هي عملية التطوير الاعتيادية التي تنتقل من النماذج المجردة ومواصفات المتطلبات إلى تنفيذ الكود المصدري.
explanation.en: Forward engineering is the conventional development process that moves from abstract models and requirement specifications down to physical source code implementation.
